name: HanumanShani
caption:
Shanivaar ko Shani dev par tel kyon chadhate hain? 🪔
Ek lokkatha kehti hai — Hanuman ji ne Shani ko poonch mein lapet kar chattanon par patka, aur phir ghaavon par tel diya. Tabhi se yeh parampara.

Comment mein 'Jai Shri Ram' likhein aur apnon ke saath share karein 🙏

#hanuman #shanidev #shanivaar #sanatandharma #hindumythology #kaalchitra
title: Shani par tel kyon chadhta hai? Hanuman aur Shani ki lokkatha
